turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to read more, but I'm always on the go.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Audiobooks might help, or an e-reader that fits in your pocket.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Which fits your day better, listening on the bus and at the gym, or reading in short quiet moments?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just a sec, I need to sort something out with my roommate. I'll say when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How was the trail you did last week?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Beautiful, but really muddy near the waterfall.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Would it be okay for the kids?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The first part, yes. The last mile is steep with loose rocks, I wouldn't bring them up there.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could just go to the waterfall and turn back.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: That's the best bit anyway. They'll love it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. We were figuring out how you can read more. Audiobooks or e-reader?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Audiobooks. I'm driving like two hours a day.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Perfect, that's a lot of books a year. Check if your library lends audiobooks for free.
